A [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] '''duel''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woteba]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], at the heights of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], between the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight-in-training]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Joiner]] [[Alema Rar]].
